It seems that the schema in the Redfish specification is not suitable, so our plan is to only keep the ResetActivated, correct?
ack
remove stray file.
Done
Matt, Patrick, opinions? Not sure if eventually we would want these coming from PSM or the handlers.... So, would really appreciate your expert opinions here.

Whats the purpose of ResetActivated. I am not able to understand its purpose from the description mentioned.


Wondering why can't you use ResetRecommended instead which is a standard redfish message.
Handles various reset events, including system resets, PCIe resets, and others.

> Handles various reset events, including system resets, PCIe resets, and others.


How is this different from ResetRecommended ?

I think they serve completely different purposes in terms of timing and semantics:

ResetRecommended is a predictive warning.
"An error occurred, so we recommend you perform a reset later.

ResetActivated is a reactive event log.
A hardware reset signal (System/PCIe) was just detected/triggered right now.

Since we are logging the actual occurrence of various reset events rather than suggesting a future recovery action, ResetRecommended is not applicable here.
Acknowledged
@peter.yin@quantatw.com There are CI failures. Please address those.
Done
The type is an object_path.  Does that mean it literally can only be a D-Bus object?  Would just being a string be sufficient so it can be anything?
Shouldn't this be the device or inventory object for which the reset is activated instead ?
How about revising the description to make the purpose clearer? Something like: 'The D-Bus object path of the device that was reset.'
